additions.text: Laundress with a museum of lost objects
I wash the hospital sheets. There is everything in the sheets: teeth, rings and a glass eye. I have a box with a hundred things.
Do you lose a lot of things?
Grandad who has been waiting for years
I am here for my knee. I have been waiting since 2019. Now my knee is fine, but the other one is bad.
Do you wait a long time for the doctor?
Influencer livestreaming her appendicitis
Hi, I am live. My tummy hurts a lot. I have ten thousand people watching my pain.
Do you use your phone a lot?
Man who sleeps here without being ill
What? Who are you? I was asleep. I am not ill, I sleep here because it is free.
Do you sleep well at night?
Man hit by the welcome sign
Look at my head. A sign fell on me. The sign says «Welcome».
Does your head hurt sometimes?
Reader of magazines from 1998
I am reading a magazine. It is very old, from 1998. All the magazines here are old.
Do you read magazines or books?
Wife of the man who swallowed the remote
I am sad. My husband ate the TV remote. Now I can't change the channel.
Do you watch a lot of TV?
Young man who lost to his grandmother
I have a broken arm. I arm-wrestled my grandmother. My grandmother is ninety and she won.
Are you strong?
Son-in-law with his eternal mother-in-law
I am here with my mother-in-law. She is ninety-eight. She is very well. I am very unwell.
Do you have grandparents?
Grandma who sells her queue number
Oh! Why are you waking me up? I have number 14. I will sell you my number for ten pesos.
Do you want to buy my number?
Man on hold with his insurance
I am talking to my health insurance. I have been on hold for four hours. The music is very bad.
What music do you listen to?
Cook with a finger in the cool box
I am a cook. I cut my finger with a knife. My finger is here, in the cool box, with the chorizo.
Can you cook?
Lady declared dead by mistake
I am alive! Look at me! The computer says I am dead. But I talk and I shout!
Do you think I am alive?
Lawyer who wanted to sue the hospital
I am a lawyer. I am very angry. I want to sue the hospital, but the hospital is suing me.
Do you get angry easily?
Woman who cannot sit down
I won't sit down, thanks. I have a problem in my bottom. I have been standing since six.
Are you tired today?
Pizza delivery man with no customer
I am bringing a pizza for room 304. But nobody pays. The patient is not here any more.
Do you like pizza?
Woman phoning reception from reception
The receptionist is there, three metres away. But she doesn't talk to people. She only answers the phone. That is why I am calling her.
Do you prefer talking on the phone or in person?
Builder with a nail in his head
I have a nail in my head. It doesn't hurt. Now I speak like a poet. I am very happy.
Do you write poems?
Man living on a stretcher
I have been on this stretcher for three days. My gown is open at the back. Everybody sees my bottom.
Are you cold?
Bleeding biker worried about her bike
I had an accident on my motorbike. I have blood on my leg. Is my bike OK?
Do you have a motorbike or a car?
Old man faking it for the jelly
Shh. I'm not ill. I come for the jelly. Here the jelly is free and it's red.
What is your favourite dessert?
Allergic to the hospital food
My face is very big. I ate the hospital soup. I am allergic to the soup.
Do you have any allergies?
Football fan who fell off the roof
Ouch, it hurts a lot! I fell off my roof. I have blood on my head. And I didn't see the final.
Do you watch football?
Nurse who has been awake 36 hours
I am a nurse. I have been working since yesterday. I don't sleep. I drink coffee from a urine cup. It is clean.
How many hours do you sleep?
Patient who adjusts her own drip
I have a drip in my arm. I change the speed. Fast, slow... It's like a cocktail!
Do you drink a lot of water?
Patient forgotten in observation
I am in observation. But nobody observes me. I observe the doctors.
Do you watch people?
Nurse who fears the cafeteria
I am a nurse. I am on my break. I don't eat the soup. The soup is dangerous.
Do you eat in the cafeteria?
Godson waiting for the inheritance
My godfather is very ill. He is rich. I am here every day. I am a good godson, right?
Do you visit your family?
Junior doctor who operates from tutorials
I am a doctor. I am twenty-six. Today I did my first operation. I watched a video online.
Do you learn things from videos?
Hypochondriac planning his own funeral
I'm talking to the funeral home. I'm planning my funeral. I'm fine, but I have a bit of a cough.
Do you go to the doctor a lot?
Woman with an absurd bill
I have the hospital bill. It is very expensive. They charge for the air I breathe!
Do you pay a lot of bills?
Son looking for his lost father
I'm looking for my dad. He's in the hospital, but nobody knows where. I talk to lots of people.
Do you get lost in big places?
Man waiting for a rubber stamp
Eh? Is it my turn yet? I need a stamp on this paper. I have been waiting two months.
Are you patient?
Kidney donor with absurd paperwork
I want to give a kidney to my brother. But the form asks for a photocopy of the kidney.
Do you have brothers or sisters?
Patient smoking thin air outside
I'm outside with my drip. I don't smoke any more. Now I smoke air. My lungs are very bad.
Do you smoke?
Man phoning the hospital from outside
I'm in the street, ten metres from the door. I'm phoning the hospital. I've been on hold with music for three hours.
Do you wait on the phone a lot?
Man who tripped over a sign
I'm on the floor. My leg hurts a lot. There's a yellow sign: «Wet floor».
Do you read the yellow signs?
Patient hit by the ceiling
I've got blood on my head. I came for a toothache. Here a piece of ceiling falls on me.
Do you look at the ceiling when you go into a building?
Woman who came in with a nosebleed
Ouch, my arm! I came by ambulance for a nosebleed. The ambulance brakes and I fly.
Are you afraid of ambulances?
Paramedic trying to quit smoking
I'm a paramedic. I've got a cigarette, but it isn't lit. Today is my fortieth day without smoking.
Do you have a bad habit?
Man who swallowed his house key
I'm in X-ray. I've got a key in my stomach. My wife is outside and can't get into the house.
Where do you keep your house keys?
Claustrophobic patient in the CT scanner
I'm very scared. The machine is small and noisy. I don't like being in here.
Are you afraid of small spaces?
Technician reading the manual
I'm a CT technician. I'm reading the machine's manual. It's my first week.
Do you read manuals?
Woman who has been waiting since Tuesday
My leg is broken. I've been waiting here since Tuesday. Today is Saturday.
Are you patient when you wait, or do you get angry?
Young man livestreaming
Hi, I'm live on my phone. My friend has a broken arm. I've got twelve followers.
Do you want to be in my video?
Freshly operated man checking his legs
They operated on me today. I've got a drip in my arm. On one leg there's a message: «Not this one».
Do you sleep well after a hard day?
Patient lying awake on the table
I'm on the operating table. I'm awake. The anaesthetist isn't here.
Can you count from one to ten in Spanish?
Surgeon with a head torch
I'm a surgeon. There's no light in the operating theatre. I use a camping torch.
Do you have a torch at home?
Eighty-one-year-old surgeon
I'm eighty-one. I've been a surgeon for fifty years. My hands shake, but only a little.
How old is the oldest person in your family?
Half-asleep anaesthetist
I'm an anaesthetist. I'm very sleepy. I'm sitting because I can't stand up.
How many hours do you sleep at night?
Nurse forty hours into her shift
I'm a nurse. I've been working since yesterday. My coffee is gone: someone stole the machine.
Do you drink coffee every day?
Doctor reading the obituaries
I'm a doctor. I read the newspaper every morning. I read the page about the dead.
Which part of the newspaper do you read first?
Medical student in the viewing gallery
I'm a medical student. I'm watching the operation through the window. Today is my first day.
Can you look at blood without a problem?
Ninety-four-year-old patient
I'm ninety-four. I've lived in this room for two years. It's my home.
Do you live alone or with your family?
Hypochondriac who is finally ill
I always say I'm ill. Now I'm really ill. Nobody believes me.
Do you go to the doctor a lot?
Patient «under observation» for weeks
I'm under observation. I've been here for three weeks. I don't know what's wrong with me.
Do you ask the doctor a lot of questions?
Patient trapped by his own bed
My head is bandaged. My bed is electric, but it's crazy. It folds up by itself.
Do you sleep in a big bed or a small one?
Funeral home owner, now a patient
I own a funeral home. Now I'm ill in hospital. I've got discount cards.
It's free. Do you want a card?
Mother in the middle of labour
Ouch! My baby is coming now! I'm in a lot of pain. My husband is on the floor.
Do you have brothers or sisters?
Midwife with four thousand births
I'm a midwife. I help babies to be born. Get that man up off the floor!
Do you know where you were born?
Father who fainted at the birth
Where am I? I'm on the floor. My wife is having a baby and I'm sleepy.
Do you faint when you see blood?
Grandmother crying in the delivery room
I'm going to be a grandmother. I'm very happy and very sad. The baby isn't going to have my name.
Do you know why you have your name?
Intubated patient with a whiteboard
(Writes on a whiteboard) I can't talk. I've got a tube in my mouth. I'm fine, thanks.
(Writes) Do you have nice handwriting?
Intubated patient who mumbles
Mmm… Hi. I don't speak well. I've got a tube. I blink: once is «yes», twice is «no».
Mmm… Do you understand me?
Hospital director, now a patient
Mmm… I'm the hospital director. Now I'm a patient. The bed is very bad.
Mmm… What do you think of the hospital?
Woman who has «died» twice
I'm alive. But the hospital says I've died twice. The man from the morgue visits me every day.
Do you believe in ghosts?
Nurse who talks to the machines
I'm an intensive care nurse. The machines have names. This one is called Lupita.
Do you give names to your things?
Daughter who flew fourteen hours
I'm Doña Pilar's daughter. I live far away, in another country. My mum is fine and I'm very tired.
Do you live near your family?
Son who visits every day
I'm Doña Pilar's son. I come here every day. I'm hugging my sister, but I'm nervous.
Do you hug your family a lot?
